vocab.definition: the unit for amount of substance (6.02×10²³ particles).
the number of particles in one mole, 6.02×10²³.
the Mᵣ in grams — the mass of one mole.

misconceptions.wrong: A mole is a unit of mass.
misconceptions.right: A mole is an amount (a count of particles).

misconceptions.wrong: One mole always weighs the same.
misconceptions.right: The mass of a mole depends on the molar mass.
It is always 6.02×10²³ particles per mole.

questions.text: Calculate the moles in 36 g of water. (Mᵣ = 18) [2 marks]
Calculate the mass of 0.5 mol of CaCO₃. (Mᵣ = 100) [2 marks]
Calculate the number of molecules in 2 mol of CO₂. [2 marks]
State what is meant by one mole of a substance. [1 mark]

questions.text: Calculate the moles in 23 g of sodium. (Aᵣ = 23) [1 mark]
